aboutBody: GSSA is a student-led organization affiliated with the [Geospatial Center at Saint Louis University](https://www.slu.edu/geospatial). It was founded in 2026 to build a community of practice around geospatial science at SLU — and to connect that community to the wider St. Louis geospatial world. **Membership is free and there are no dues.** Any enrolled SLU undergraduate or graduate student may join. Faculty, staff, alumni and practitioners are welcome as Affiliate Members. GSSA governs its own activities and decisions. The Geospatial Center and Faculty Advisor provide guidance, support and institutional continuity, but do not control student votes or elections.
